title: Blockchain Developer
summary: A blockchain developer writes smart contracts (programs that run on a blockchain) and the backend code that connects them to apps, on public chains like Ethereum or private ones like Hyperledger Fabric. They sit in a product team at a web3 startup, fintech or IT services firm, working with backend, front-end and security engineers.
dailyDuties: Write and update smart contracts in Solidity or Fabric chaincode
Write unit tests for contracts and run them before every deployment
Deploy contracts to test networks and check them on a block explorer
Build backend APIs that read from and write to the chain
Review contract code for security issues and gas cost
Fix issues raised in internal or external audits

skills.expectation: Write, test and deploy smart contracts on Ethereum or another EVM chain, or on Hyperledger Fabric
Write, test and deploy smart contracts on Ethereum or another EVM chain, or on Hyperledger Fabric
Build the backend services and chaincode that talk to the chain
Build the backend services and chaincode that talk to the chain
Avoid common contract bugs such as reentrancy and prepare code for audits
Understand hashing, public and private keys and digital signatures
Write automated tests for contracts and services before deployment
Expose blockchain features to apps through REST APIs
Work in Git with branches and pull requests
Connect apps and wallets to contracts with ethers.js or web3.js
Run local chains and Fabric networks in containers
Write typed backend and test code

groups.label: A smart contract platform (Solidity/EVM or Hyperledger Fabric)
A backend language for chain services (Node.js or Go)
